title: Steering Vector Registry and Reproducibility Repository

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: a public registry reduces duplicated effort and enables meta-analysis. Impact on safety is indirect — it is infrastructure rather than a direct safety finding. The theory of change requires adoption by multiple labs to have effect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Creating a HuggingFace dataset with pre-computed vectors is well within the skill set of CS students. Extracting concept vectors using existing code (Beaglehole et al.) on open-source models is documented. Medium compute is sufficient for a few model families.

narrow_scope.reasoning: The registry concept is broad — covering multiple model families, extraction methods, and metadata schemas. Scoping to a single model family with a small set of concepts would be tight, but as stated the project invites scope creep across 'major open-source model families'.
